Fourteen comments

The Humours Of Ballingarry (jig)

I learned this tune off the recent debut album of Hugh and Colm Healy from Corofin, Clare. Also on Angelina Carberry and Martin Quinn’s duet recording. While Martin Quinn writes he found it in O’Neill’s, Healy brothers don’t mention the source of the tune. Anyway, you can see them playing this tune: http://www.custysmusic.com/mall/CustysTraditionalMusicShop/hugh_and_colm_healy.htm

↳ Posted by slainte on February 2nd, 2005.

The Buck In The Woods, X:5

I learnt this from Seán Potts this year in Spiddal. He played it quite straight (as written) at first to teach it, but when he played it through a few times he added runs and different jumps throughout. Often instead of playing GG at the start of the first part, he would play GB, especially when playing it faster.

↳ Posted by James Dumbelton on December 30th, 2022.
